Proof done. `/work/putnam_2006_b6.lean` compiles with no errors and no `sorry` warning.

Approach:
- **Helper lemma `key_bound`** (added above the docstring): mean value theorem bounds `(x + h)^(1+q) - x^(1+q)` with `h = 1/x^q` between `1+q` and `(1+q)(1 + 1/x^(1+q))^q`.
- **Main proof:** `w n = (a n)^(1+q)`, `q = 1/k`. Step `w(n+1) - w n` lies in `[1+q, (1+q)(1+1/w n)^q]`. Since `w n ≥ n(1+q)`, the upper bound tends to `1+q`, so the step tends to `1+q` by squeeze. Cesàro (`Filter.Tendsto.cesaro`) then gives `w n / n → 1+q`. Raising to the `k`-th power gives `a n^(k+1)/n^k → ((k+1)/k)^k`.

Nothing else in the file changed except the added lemma. No `axiom`, `admit`, `native_decide`, `#eval`, or metaprogramming.
